title: QA Team Lead (Web Scraping & Data Extraction)
description:
About Actowiz Solutions Actowiz Solutions is a leading provider of web scraping, data extraction, and market intelligence solutions. We help global enterprises collect, process, and deliver structured data from eCommerce, Quick Commerce, Retail, Travel, Food Delivery, Automotive, Real Estate, and other digital platforms. We are looking for an experienced QA Team Lead who can lead a team of QA Engineers, ensure high-quality client deliveries, improve QA processes, and collaborate closely with developers and project managers to maintain exceptional data quality across multiple web scraping projects. 
 Role Overview As a QA Team Lead, you will be responsible for leading day-to-day QA activities across multiple web scraping and data extraction projects. You will mentor QA Engineers, establish testing standards, review deliverables, identify process improvements, and ensure that every client delivery meets the required quality benchmarks. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, excellent analytical abilities, and hands-on experience validating large-scale scraped datasets. 
 Key Responsibilities Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and guide a team of QA Engineers. Assign QA tasks and monitor daily progress. Conduct regular knowledge-sharing sessions and team training. Review team performance and provide constructive feedback. Support recruitment, onboarding, and mentoring of new QA team members. 
 Data Quality Assurance Validate datasets for: Accuracy Completeness Freshness Consistency Formatting Duplicate records Review client deliverables before submission. Ensure adherence to project-specific validation checklists and SOPs. Verify data against client requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 Testing & Validation Prepare detailed test plans and test cases for scraping projects. Perform functional and regression testing of web scrapers and APIs. Validate parser outputs after website structure changes. Identify missing fields, incorrect mappings, duplicate records, and formatting inconsistencies. Perform sanity checks before production deliveries. 
 Scraper Validation Test web scraping applications, crawlers, APIs, and ETL pipelines. Monitor scraping performance and data quality after deployments. Validate outputs across multiple websites and data sources. Coordinate with developers to resolve extraction and parsing issues. 
 Process Improvement Improve QA processes, validation methodologies, and checklists. Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive actions. Maintain documentation for QA processes and project-specific validations. Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality and efficiency. 
 Reporting & Coordination Coordinate with Project Managers, Developers, Business Analysts, and Delivery teams. Track QA progress across multiple projects. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QA reports. Escalate critical quality issues and project risks proactively. Ensure project deliveries meet defined SLAs and timelines. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 3-6 years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a QA team. Experience working on web scraping, data extraction, or data validation projects. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 Technical Skills Must Have Strong understanding of: HTML DOM XPath CSS Selectors JSON XML Hands-on experience with: SQL REST APIs Data validation techniques Experience testing: Web Scrapers Crawlers APIs ETL Pipelines Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies. Strong understanding of Excel and large dataset validation. 
 Preferred Skills Basic knowledge of Python scripting for QA automation. Experience with distributed web scraping frameworks. Understanding of proxy management and anti-bot mechanisms. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. Exposure to automated data validation frameworks. Experience in a Web Scraping, Market Intelligence, or Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) company. 
 Leadership Expectations The QA Team Lead should be capable of: Managing a team of QA Engineers effectively. Handling multiple client projects simultaneously. Ensuring on-time project deliveries with high quality. Mentoring junior QA team members. Coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams. Driving continuous process improvements within the QA function. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Data Accuracy (%) First-Time Right (FTR) Defect Leakage Rate Production Defects On-Time Delivery SLA Compliance Team Productivity Quality Audit Score Client Acceptance Rate Root Cause Closure Rate QA Documentation Compliance Client Satisfaction (CSAT) 
 Why Join Actowiz Solutions Work on global web scraping and market intelligence projects. Lead a talented and growing QA team. Gain exposure to cutting-edge data extraction technologies. Enjoy continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven work environment. 
 If you have a passion for quality, leadership, and large-scale data validation, we would love to have you join the Actowiz Solutions team. Required Skills quality assurance python webscraping

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in software quality assurance, test planning, test execution, defect management, API and database testing, and automation framework development. The candidate should have a strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and modern QA practices. Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright is expected, with Playwright preferred. The role will involve working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable, and scalable software releases. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Planning Strategy: Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to define test strategies, scope, effort, timelines, and test coverage. Manual Testing: Design and execute comprehensive test cases and scenarios covering functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and UAT testing. Test Documentation: Create and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, test data, test execution reports, and other QA documentation. Automation Testing: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard automation tools and frameworks. Automation Framework Development: Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, or Appium. Regression Smoke Automation: Automate regression and smoke test suites to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and release cycles. Defect Management: Identify, document, track, prioritize, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. API Testing: Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, and Swagger/OpenAPI. Database Testing: Validate database records, data integrity, data flow, and backend processes using SQL and relational databases. End-to-End Testing: Validate complete business workflows across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems. CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices. Quality Risk Management: Perform risk-based testing, identify potential quality risks, and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation approaches. Performance Optimization: Analyze test execution and automation results, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. Release Validation: Support release and deployment validation activities and ensure software meets defined quality standards before production release. Quality Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, tools, frameworks, and best practices. Technical Contribution: Participate in code reviews, test strategy discussions, technical discussions, and automation roadmap planning. Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to building overall team capabilities. 
 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Software Testing and Quality Assurance. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) . Strong experience in both Manual and Automation Testing . Hands-on experience with one or more automation tools such as: Selenium WebDriver Cypress Playwright (Preferred) TestNG / JUnit Cucumber / BDD Appium Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language such as Java, Python, or JavaScript . Strong knowledge of SQL and database testing. Hands-on experience with API testing using Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, or Swagger/OpenAPI . Experience working with CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, Maven, or Gradle . Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, HP ALM/Quality Center, or Azure DevOps . Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Hands-on experience with Playwright and modern automation frameworks. Experience developing and maintaining scalable automation frameworks. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner . Experience testing Microservices Architecture . Strong knowledge of API automation frameworks. Understanding of Security and Accessibility Testing . Experience with healthcare domain applications, including HIPAA, HL7, EHR/EMR, Claims, Eligibility, or Revenue Cycle . Experience with FHIR-based integrations . Exposure to MCP and AI-assisted workflow testing . Familiarity with modern CI/CD and continuous testing practices. Experience with test automation reporting, monitoring, and quality metrics.
